metadata.title: Medicinal Products (Control of Placing on the Market) (Amendment) Regulations 2012 (S.I. No. 272 of 2012)
metadata.edition: Made 25 July 2012 (no commencement clause read; date is a placeholder) · inserts Part 7 Pharmacovigilance (Regulations 30 to 38) into S.I. No. 540 of 2007: Reg. 31 QPPV in the EEA, contact person in the State; Reg. 32 Eudravigilance 15 / 90 days; Reg. 25(9) transitional (English)
metadata.legal_basis: Statutory instrument of Ireland; the official text governs.
metadata.applicability: Holders of marketing authorisations and certificates of traditional-use registration (see the PV Info HPRA-IE national addendum; ICSR clocks are in the EMA rulebook).

metadata_verification: Source-register metadata; dates and legal status require human verification.
limitations: English rule-based extraction; no GPT or paid API.
